findings.title: Tapped controls keep their hover paint on iPhone (red bell, grey rows, faded chips) until the next tap elsewhere
findings.evidence: 112 :hover lines in style.css, one @media (hover:hover) block (:11768, sticker menu); e.g. .btn:hover :1021, .sub-row-pin/bell:hover :8833 (paints a just-enabled bell red), .md-row:hover :8424, .card-download-btn:hover :1853, .modern-chip:hover :9912; dl chip dim until hover :9086-9089
findings.cause: Hover is authored as a desktop-only model with no pointer gate, and touch feedback lives on :hover instead of :active.
findings.fix: Wrap every :hover in @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine); move touch feedback to :active; rest the dl chip fully opaque on touch.

findings.title: Long-press on cards, links, avatars and chrome triggers iOS link previews, Save-image sheets and text selection
findings.evidence: -webkit-touch-callout:none on only 3 sites (style.css:3705, 6827, 11827); -webkit-user-select on 4 lines; card main.js:2635-2645; no html-level policy; thumbnails draggable on desktop (user-drag only on reorder rows :3714)
findings.cause: There is no app-wide native-interaction policy; each surface opts out on its own and almost none do.
findings.fix: Apply the locked policy: html chrome user-select/touch-callout none, editable fields opt back in last in file order, copy via explicit actions, img/a drag off.
findings.primitive: Interaction policy (root rule + editable escape hatch + both-spellings lint + reading-content census)

findings.title: Card titles and channel names render in old-style link blue on Home (#03c light, #3ea6ff dark)
findings.evidence: style.css:808-810 global a{color:var(--text-link)}; .video-title 2062-2074 sets no color; --text-link #03c at :99/:356 (2021 light), #3ea6ff :379
findings.cause: Card title/byline anchors inherit the global link colour because the card text rules never set an ink colour.
findings.fix: Give card title/byline primary/secondary ink; keep link colour only for prose links, and give Modern a modern link hue.
findings.primitive: MediaMeta text styles + Link primitive (prose only); lint: no anchor inside a card without an explicit ink token

findings.title: The duration pill is the biggest text on a card (18px on phones vs a 12px title), and is 14/18/11px across views
findings.evidence: style.css:1667-1690 (14px), :15547 phone --fs-2xl 18px, :15554-15557 list 11px; reused at history.js:98, watch.js:1786
findings.cause: v1.205.1 matched the pill height to the corner buttons by inflating font-size instead of fixing a box height.
findings.fix: Fixed-height badge (20/22px) with fs-xs/sm tabular-nums text; corner buttons share the height token.

findings.title: Every thumbnail carries three always-on overlay pills, including a trash can, and sibling pills hover differently (Download turns red)
findings.evidence: defaults main.js:627 {download, delete, like}; opacity .85 on --scrim style.css:1783-1917, 14535-14547; download hover red :1853-1857, queue --scrim-heavy :14549, others opacity only :1895-1904; feed-hide ban glyph main.js:2649
findings.cause: Corner controls were built touch-first as hand-copied blocks and never got an overflow menu.
findings.fix: At most one resting overlay (duration) plus a kebab/long-press menu on touch; reveal corners on hover only on hover-capable devices; Delete out of default corners.
findings.primitive: OverlayIconButton + Card action menu (Interaction policy long-press)
findings.decision: Should the default card corners drop Delete (and Download) in favour of a kebab/long-press menu?

findings.title: On the watch channel card the only red button is Pin channel, the least important action; before subscribing Subscribe and Pin are both red
findings.evidence: watch.js:2473 classList.toggle('btn-primary', !pinned); 2361-2367 Subscribe; comment 2458-2462; also Subs 'Check all' red SUBS.html:320-325 and Podcasts '+ Add podcast' red
findings.cause: Red is applied per toggle as 'not yet done' instead of by role, so the primary colour lands on whichever toggle is off.
findings.fix: Variant fixed by role (Subscribe primary only when unsubscribed; Pin/Notify always secondary toggles with one pressed look); at most one primary per group.
findings.primitive: Button variant + ToggleButton (pressed axis) + one-primary-per-group lint

findings.title: The player's controls mix CSS-drawn shapes, a Material cog, text dingbats that can render as emoji, and system-monospace timestamps
findings.evidence: play/pause CSS borders style.css:6325-6341; mute clip-path :6365-6395; fullscreen text U+26F6 watch.html:542; cog values '1x','CC','⧉' watch.html:548-550; '2× ▶▶' badge watch.html:494 (exempted in icon-assets.test.js:73) | merged: Timestamps in the player use the system monospace font inside a Geist UI - .pc-time font-family var(--mono-font) style.css:6275-6283, --mono-font: monospace :82/:340; scrub preview :7876-7884
findings.cause: Each player glyph was built with whatever technique was at hand; no registry covers the player.
findings.fix: Draw every player glyph from one icon registry (play, pause, volume, fullscreen, PiP, CC, speed). Also: Geist with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
findings.primitive: Icon (registry, SVG only) + lint: no dingbat textContent in controls

findings.title: The video sits on top of a permanent solid control strip (80px on phones) instead of overlay chrome
findings.evidence: style.css:6848-6870 40px reserved strip; :6720-6800 two-row 80px phone bar; solid --header-bg :6258-6273; never auto-hides
findings.cause: v1.23.5 chose a docked bar on purpose.
findings.fix: If revisited: overlay bar on a bottom gradient scrim that auto-hides after ~3s and reveals on tap.
findings.decision: Keep the permanent control strip under the video, or move to overlay auto-hiding chrome?

findings.title: Settings is built from OS checkboxes that render blue (and white light-mode boxes in dark mode), as do selects and the file input
findings.evidence: 29 type=checkbox in setup.html; accent-color appears once in style.css (.whcal-step :15710); color-scheme only on the player wrapper :6255; real switch exists .watch-autoplay-switch :2816; raw file input setup.html:1080
findings.cause: No Toggle primitive and no color-scheme/accent-color floor, so native controls keep UA styling.
findings.fix: Replace boolean settings with the existing switch; set :root accent-color and color-scheme:dark in dark mode as a floor.

findings.title: Buttons have no real size scale: 28/31/32/36/39/44px heights, and the 'btn-sm' class used 83 times has no CSS rule at all
findings.evidence: .btn style.css:986-1003 no height/line-height (measured spread :3010-3020); .btn-sm appears only in comments (:1206, :4015); 83 uses across public/js, lib/ytdlp/client, HTML; 18 padding pairs, 7 font sizes, 8 radius forms (census 3.1)
findings.cause: The button is a bag of per-surface patches with no size contract, and a vestigial class hides that 'small' buttons are full size.
findings.fix: Button sizes sm/md/lg with explicit height and line-height:1; retire btn-sm.
findings.primitive: Button + lint: every class used in JS/HTML exists in CSS

findings.title: Glyphs drawn as text symbols (★ ☆ ⋮ ✓ × ‹ ▴▾ ✎ ♪) come from a fallback font and sit off-centre next to SVG icons
findings.evidence: ★☆⋮✓ absent from geist/roboto cmap; SUBS:2771 pin, SUBS:2807 kebab, POD:860 played ✓; × 41 sites (common.js:4203, 6083...), ‹ SUBS.html:352, ▴▾ common.js:4772, ✎ ♪ main.js:2107/2158; v1.340 fixed this only on the watch page (common.js:117)
findings.cause: No rule requires a control's glyph to come from the icon registry; the v1.340 fix was not applied to siblings.
findings.fix: Replace every text glyph in controls with registry SVGs.
findings.primitive: Icon + lint: no × ✕ ▶ ★ ☆ ← → ‹ › ✓ ⋮ in UI markup outside skins

findings.title: Red text is about 3:1 on dark backgrounds (fails AA): errors, Clear all, 'View as Playlist', back chevrons, sign out
findings.evidence: --yt-red defined only in light era blocks (style.css:90, 350, 407, 463, 522); --text-link is re-tuned for dark (:377...); #cc0000 on #121212 ≈3.0:1; hard-delete warning 2.4:1
findings.cause: The dark palette is a background-only swap; the accent is never re-tuned for text in dark mode.
findings.fix: Split --accent (fills) from --accent-text per mode (dark ≈ #ff4e45); contrast unit test over era x mode tokens.

findings.title: Red means brand, selected, hover, focus, active tab, 'Undo' and destructive all at once
findings.evidence: bottom-nav active :5497; sort/speed/chapter/CC selected :1564/:7238/:7157/:7206; queue Clear :14369; toast action :14603; focus .md-row :8427; sticker .is-on vs .mms-sm-danger :11764/:11780; dl chip active vs error both red :9133/:9142
findings.cause: There are no --selected, --danger, --focus-ring or status roles, so every state reaches for --yt-red.
findings.fix: Add semantic roles; restrict --yt-red to primary CTA, progress and brand.
findings.primitive: Semantic color tokens + lint: var(--yt-red) only in primitive variants

findings.title: The same channel is a square avatar on the watch page and Subscriptions but a circle in notifications and cards (12 treatments, 9 sizes, 6-7 builders)
findings.evidence: square: .uploader-avatar style.css:3089, .sub-row-avatar :3900 (bevel), .sub-sheet-avatar :8633, .comment-avatar :3275; circle: .notif-row-avatar :13796, .card-channel-avatar :9983, .pinned-avatar :8877; builders common.js:646/743/6380/11800, SUBS:1399, watch.js:1542; pins/subs have no onerror
findings.cause: Every surface builds and shapes its own avatar.
findings.fix: One Avatar (circle for people/channels, sizes xs-xl) with one fallback chain photo > artwork > monogram and one onerror.

findings.title: Card and watch pages show fabricated stars, view counts, subscriber counts and commenters by default
findings.evidence: star rows common.js:500-503 default shown, card-rating style.css:3058-3065; mock views/subs common.js:3055-3070, 1596-1606; mock comments watch.js:2965-2976; ★☆ from fallback font
findings.cause: Retro house style decoration shipped on by default in the Modern era.
findings.fix: Default ft-hide-stars (and mock counts) off in Modern; keep as a 2005/2009 era flourish.
findings.decision: Should fake stars/views/subscriber counts/comments default off in the Modern era?

findings.title: The Notify bell glyph sits visibly below the centre of its 'Notifying' label
findings.evidence: style.css:4946 .btn .btn-glyph 1.15em box, vertical-align:-0.2em, negative block margins; watch.js:2482 (the subs audit's 0.3px estimate was wrong: the render shows the drop)
findings.cause: Glyphs are centred by per-site vertical-align on a text run rather than by a flex icon slot.
findings.fix: Put the glyph in a fixed flex icon slot centred by the box; drop vertical-align on icons.
findings.primitive: Icon slot in Button (ui-btn__icon) + geometry assertion: icon centre within 0.5px of label x-height centre

findings.title: On phones the watch action row buttons are 39px with 11px text, while the channel-card buttons directly below are 44px with 12px text
findings.evidence: style.css:15462-15464 .watch-actions .btn --size-touch-watch-action 39px; :5750-5754 11px, 6/10 padding; :15323 global .btn 44px floor; 2px slack at 360px :5838-5846
findings.cause: Button height is set by ancestor-scoped overrides instead of a size prop.
findings.fix: One Button size scale (sm 32 / md 36 / lg 44) chosen per group; the action row scrolls horizontally instead of trimming type.
findings.primitive: Button size tokens (--control-h-*) + geometry assertion: buttons in one row share a height

findings.title: Media titles and meta are tiny on phones (12/11/10px on a full-width tile) and styled differently on every surface, History and queue included
findings.evidence: card title 13px/500 style.css:2062-2074, phone 12px :6072-6076, byline 11 / meta 10 :6078-6084; Related 12px 700 + 10px meta :3349-3375; History 15px 600 :14718; queue 12px 400 :14444 | merged: History and queue rows follow their own conventions (15px semibold titles, 10px caps chip, ▴▾ text arrows, red remove hovers, sub-44px targets) - history title style.css:14718-14728, chip :14745-14754, remove :14757-14775; queue ▴▾ common.js:4772, × :4841, red hover :14484, red Clear :14369
findings.cause: Each surface sets its own title/meta type; the 1px-step type scale invites near-duplicates.
findings.fix: Three shared media text styles scaled by tile width (feed 15-16, grid 13-14, rail 13). Also: ListRow + Thumb + MediaMeta shared by history, queue and the watch rail.
findings.primitive: MediaMeta + collapsed type roles (caption 11, meta 12, body 14, title 16, heading 20, display 32)

findings.title: Filter chips: the Home feed shows two chip rows each starting with 'All', chips are 44px pills on phones, and hover lightens them toward the background
findings.evidence: .modern-chip style.css:9901-9918; .section-actions .btn restyled :1348-1367; toolbars :1384-1401; hover --bg-sidebar lighter than resting --bg-secondary :9912/:1355; 44px floor :15323; search chips wrap :1724; channel sticky toolbar two rows :5969-6030
findings.cause: The chip recipe is copied four times on top of .btn, so each copy inherits the button floor and its own hover.
findings.fix: One Chip (32px pill, hover darkens a step, selected state) in a single horizontally scrolling row per view.

findings.title: Tapping a bottom-bar tab or a notification row underlines its text (and it sticks on iOS)
findings.evidence: global a:hover underline style.css:813-815 (0,1,1) beats .bottom-nav-item none :5486 and .notif-row none :13789; only .sidebar-item re-declares :1168-1170
findings.cause: A global element-level link hover rule outranks component resets.
findings.fix: Scope underline to a prose Link; nav items and rows never underline.

findings.title: Toggle labels change width on tap (Like/Liked, Mark watched/Watched, Share/Copied!), shoving the rest of the row
findings.evidence: watch.js:3160, 3237, 3318; stableToggleLabelHtml common.js:120 used only for Subscribe/Pin/Notify (watch.js:2361/2471/2482)
findings.cause: The stable-width label fix from v1.340 was applied to three buttons, not to the sibling toggles (inert sibling).
findings.fix: Every toggle Button takes both labels and renders the stable stack.
findings.primitive: ToggleButton (labels:[on,off]) + census: no textContent ternary on .btn-label

findings.title: Holding the video for 2x speed can raise the iOS text loupe / selection
findings.evidence: player.js:4721-4770 engageHold at 500ms; passive touchstart/touchmove :4870/:4886; opt-out only on the gesture surface style.css:6819-6828; .pc-time unprefixed user-select only :6282 (inert on iOS, as are :2812, :3758, :13938)
findings.cause: Only the gesture surface opts out; neighbouring text is selectable and nothing cancels the native long-press during a hold.
findings.fix: App policy covers the player host; selectstart/contextmenu preventDefault and non-passive touchmove only while the hold is active.
findings.primitive: Interaction policy + both-spellings user-select lint + jsdom hold-guard binding tests

findings.title: Rotating a phone in Pocket Classic tears the skin down and rebuilds it, replaying a 1.6s art zoom, shimmer and marquee (the 'visual resize'); the Music list then returns at the wrong scroll position
findings.evidence: width gate music-skins.js:334 isMobileViewport (max-width:768); skin-surface.js:2894-2918 watchSkinViewport; innerHTML rebuild ~2003; .ipm-art-img scale 1.08->1 over 1.6s style.css:12192-12194 | merged: Exiting Pocket after a rotation returns the Music list to the wrong scroll position - body-scroll-lock.js:37-42 saves Y, :67-81 restores scrollTo(0,y) across a width change
findings.cause: A width breakpoint is used as a mode switch, so landscape exits the skin and portrait rebuilds it from scratch.
findings.fix: Per the ruling, gate on phone (coarse pointer + min(w,h)<=500), keep Pocket up on rotation with a landscape layout, and never replay entry motion for a same-URL cover. Also: Anchor-based restore (first visible row key + offset) when width changed since lock.
findings.primitive: Device-class gate helper + jsdom test that a returning same-URL art is born is-in

findings.title: Subscription rows show a wall of developer text (quality: best, Downloads since, Last checked: timestamp - ok, raw channel URL)
findings.evidence: row meta in subscriptions.js row builder (~SUBS:2700-2760); render shows 7-line meta per row squeezing the name to 4 lines
findings.cause: Diagnostic fields are rendered as the row's secondary line instead of in the settings sheet.
findings.fix: One quiet meta line (e.g. 'Video · 3 new · checked 2h ago'); move quality, dates and URL into the row's settings sheet.
findings.primitive: ListRow (title + one meta line) + copy rule

findings.title: The description box shows 'File Size / Type / File Path' in bold and monospace plus a self-hosting boilerplate paragraph under every video
findings.evidence:
watch.html:352-354 meta line bold 12px; watch.html:386-390 File Path +

+ 'This file is self-hosted on your network...'
findings.cause: Developer/debug copy was never moved behind a disclosure.
findings.fix: One quiet meta line ('4 months ago · 41.5 MB · MP4'); path and boilerplate into an 'About this file' disclosure with a Copy path action.
findings.primitive: Copy rule + explicit Copy action (Interaction policy)
findings.decision: Remove the self-hosting boilerplate and hide the file path behind 'About this file'?

findings.title: Subscriptions and Podcasts toolbars use two different button systems (12px-radius semibold shadowed vs 999px pill regular), and one Podcasts screen shows both
findings.evidence: .sub-pill style.css:8357-8361 + .btn :986-1003; .music-toolbar-actions .btn :1384-1396; Podcasts '‹ All podcasts', Pin, Pause checks, Unsubscribe are square .btn POD:559, 617-639
findings.cause: The pill look is a descendant-selector context override, so shape depends on DOM position.
findings.fix: Button shape prop set by a Toolbar/ActionGroup for every list page.

findings.title: Podcast episode rows carry five 28px circle actions, crushing titles to about 15 characters; 'Played' is a red fill, the loudest mark in the row
findings.evidence: .podcast-ep-action/.podcast-like-toggle/.podcast-played-toggle style.css:15158-15240 (margin-right spacing, 14px glyphs); played red fill #fff :15174-15181; liked red outline :15242
findings.cause: Every episode action is a resting inline button and status reuses the accent red.
findings.fix: Keep one or two resting actions (play/queue) plus a kebab; show Played as quiet meta, not a red fill.
findings.primitive: IconButton + ListRow trailing slots + Chip status tones

findings.title: Notification rows' thumbnail and dot columns shift by 36-44px because the delete button exists only on media rows; arming delete widens it and re-wraps the title
findings.evidence: delete only when kind==='media' common.js:4272-4285, inserted :4339-4340; min-width 36px style.css:13737-13790, 44px phone :15337; 'Sure?' label :13765-13782. The unread dot always reserves its slot (common.js:4190, style.css:13895-13904)
findings.cause: Optional trailing controls take space only when present; confirmation is an in-flow label.
findings.fix: Fixed trailing slots (an absent action renders an empty slot); confirm in a popover or fixed-width state.
findings.primitive: ListRow slot grid + ConfirmAction + geometry assertion: identical slot x-offsets per list

findings.title: The Podcasts nav icon shows only a sliver (one of three shapes)
findings.evidence: CHROME_ICON_SVG.podcast common.js:34 holds only the stem path; public/assets/icons/podcast.svg has a circle + two paths; shells hard-code the same path (index.html:373, watch.html:577, history.html:207); chrome-icons.test.js:86-93 checks only the first <path>
findings.cause: The icon extractor keeps the first path, and its test asserts the same truncation.
findings.fix: Convert the asset to one compound path and make the extractor fail on multi-shape assets.
findings.primitive: Icon registry + extractor test that rejects multi-element assets

findings.title: Overlays are 22 hand-built families: different scrims, surfaces, radii, shadows and motion; half slide or fade, half pop in
findings.evidence: census 3.5: 6 backgrounds, 3 radii, 3 shadows, 8 backdrops; oneoff/hard-delete/podcasts-add/reloc/speed-sheet no transition (style.css:4605, 8920, 15264, 10606, 7247); speed sheet 4px radius; hard-delete/crop raw .65/.6 scrims; max-height 85vh not safe-area :4644/:8941/:10630; modal footers differ :4213/:8985/:4760/:4225
findings.cause: Each feature copies position:fixed;inset:0 plus its own panel instead of a shared overlay.
findings.fix: One Sheet (bottom/popover/dialog/panel) with one surface, radius, shadow, scrim, motion and footer layout.
findings.primitive: Sheet + lint: no position:fixed;inset:0 or raw scrim outside the primitive

findings.title: Header icon buttons are hand-rolled 7 times and are about 34px targets on phones; desktop header mixes a bevelled 'Download' text button with flat round icons
findings.evidence: .theme-toggle :1083, .modern-view-toggle :9837, .modern-sort-btn :9856, .search-toggle-btn :10006, .notif-bell-btn :13576, .queue-btn :14265, .account-menu-trigger :13919; none in the 44px floor :15321-15375; header Download .btn common.js:7410-7416
findings.cause: No IconButton primitive, so each header control re-declares shape and misses the touch floor.
findings.fix: Ghost IconButton (44px touch) for every header control; header Download becomes an icon.

findings.title: Pin looks different on each surface: red 'Pin channel' on watch, grey 'Pin to Playlists' on Podcasts, gold star chip on Subscriptions; Notify is gold on Subscriptions but uncoloured on watch
findings.evidence: watch.js:2471-2473; POD:559-565; SUBS:2766-2771 + gold #e0a800 raw hex style.css:8843-8846; Notify watch.js:2482 vs SUBS:3152-3165
findings.cause: Each surface picks its own variant, copy and pressed colour for the same toggles.
findings.fix: PinToggle/NotifyToggle presets with one label set, glyph and pressed token (--toggle-on).

findings.title: Destructive actions have no consistent treatment: one-tap Unsubscribe with no confirm, red-text Delete beside red-filled Save, neutral Empty trash/Restore, inline red Delete
findings.evidence: watch Subscribed unsubscribes on one tap watch.js:2433-2455; sub sheet Delete/Save SUBS:3014/3023 style.css:8760; Podcasts Unsubscribe 45-char confirm label POD:637-651; neutral destructive setup.html:398/872/975/1082, setup.js:3318; watch.html:308 inline red; no .btn-danger exists; users table 7 equal buttons setup.js:3290-3319
findings.cause: There is no danger variant or shared confirm pattern, so each surface improvises.
findings.fix: Button variant=danger (quiet at rest) + one ConfirmAction pattern; row kebab for admin tables.

findings.title: Disabled and busy buttons still hover and press; Notify/Pin dim to 60% on every tap during the round trip; the busy spinner widens the button
findings.evidence: .btn:disabled opacity only style.css:3514-3517; .btn:hover :1021 and :active translateY :1030-1033 not gated; watch.js:2513/2560 disabled during fetch; .btn-busy::after :3518-3528
findings.cause: Pending is expressed as disabled, and state rules are not scoped to :enabled.
findings.fix: Hover/active only on :enabled; a pending state with a spinner in a reserved icon slot at full opacity.

findings.title: Almost no control has a pressed (:active) state, so taps give either the grey iOS flash or nothing
findings.evidence: 9 :active rules in style.css (.btn:active :1030); -webkit-tap-highlight-color only in music skins :11863-11864
findings.cause: Touch feedback was never designed; hover stands in for it.
findings.fix: Give every primitive a pressed tint (--press-tint), then make tap-highlight transparent globally.

findings.title: Focus indication is missing or inconsistent: Settings inputs and the header search remove the outline with no replacement; others use red, grey or the browser default
findings.evidence: .form-group input outline:none style.css:3430 with no :focus rule; .search-input outline:none :934, no :focus-within on .search-form; .md-row :focus-visible 2px red :8427; sub row 1px :3888-3892; login red focus = error colour :10817-10821
findings.cause: Outlines were removed without a shared focus token.
findings.fix: One --focus-ring applied by Field, Button, IconButton and ListRow via :focus-visible.
findings.primitive: Field + focus-ring token + lint: outline:none needs a :focus-visible sibling

findings.title: Crossing the phone breakpoint animates the sidebar and the whole content column's margin, so layout slides and reflows mid-rotation
findings.evidence: .main-content transition margin-left style.css:1425; .sidebar transition transform :1119; mobile translateX(-230px) :5408, margin-left 0 :5413; baseline 3-to-portrait frames show the squeezed landscape layout for ~43-123ms
findings.cause: A transition sits on a layout property that a media query changes.
findings.fix: No transitions on layout properties; add an html.ft-vp-settling class that kills transitions during viewport changes.
findings.primitive: Motion tokens + lint: no transition on margin/width/height/inset/all

findings.title: The Subscriptions header shows a moon theme toggle that no other page's header has
findings.evidence: lib/ytdlp/views/subscriptions.html:198 #theme-toggle-btn; absent from public/*.html headers (theme lives in the bottom-nav/account menu)
findings.cause: The subscriptions shell's duplicated header drifted from the other 12 shells.
findings.fix: Remove it (or add it everywhere); generate the header from one template/sprite.
findings.primitive: Shared shell header + parity test across shells

findings.title: Settings 'Shows folders' tile shows an info (i) icon
findings.evidence: setup.html:521 data-md-icon="tv"; MD_ICON_PATHS (common.js:5550-5577) has no 'tv' key, so mdSvg falls back to MD_ICON_PATHS.info (common.js:5592)
findings.cause: A missing registry key silently falls back to 'info'.
findings.fix: Add a tv glyph; make an unknown icon name throw in tests instead of falling back.
findings.primitive: Icon registry + test: every data-md-icon resolves

findings.title: Subscription rows: optional pin chip and Retry move the bell/pin columns, and Retry is a 44px text button among 32px chips
findings.evidence: SUBS:2716-2744 Retry, 2763-2776 pin only when navigable, 2786-2795 bell, 2802-2812 kebab; .sub-row plain flex style.css:3862-3869; chips 32px :1049-1058/:15330
findings.cause: Trailing controls render conditionally in a flex row with no reserved slots.
findings.fix: Reserved trailing slots; Retry as IconButton sm or inside the status line.

findings.title: Podcast show header: Pin sits alone on one line, Pause/Unsubscribe on the next, the show title repeats, and Pin flashes disabled while pins load
findings.evidence: POD:559-594 Pin in .podcast-show-meta (align-self:flex-start; margin 4px 0 style.css:11396); buildManageRow POD:615-680 (margin-top 6px :15253); Pin disabled POD:568
findings.cause: Actions are appended in two places with ad-hoc margins, and disabled stands in for loading.

findings.title: Podcast sources sometimes show a generated letter avatar instead of their artwork, and a yt-dlp podcast's cover is a cropped video frame

rootCauses.title: No component layer: tokens exist, primitives do not
rootCauses.detail: css-token-lint reports 0 violations via 346 token-exempt comments and 320 of 329 hex colours moved into custom properties, but composition is free: 419 <button> tags + 125 createElement('button'), only 127 carry .btn, 61 bespoke button families; 18 button padding pairs, 7 font sizes, 8 radius forms; .btn styled by 41 rules across lines 32-15323; 83 uses of a btn-sm class with no rule; 43 distinct px heights.

rootCauses.title: Five icon rendering systems with per-site metrics
rootCauses.detail: CSS masks (143 icon-set scoped rules), inline chrome SVG, 24-grid stroke SVGs at 1.7/2/2.4, skin SVGs, and text glyphs (× 41, ▶ 25, ★ 15, → 14, ‹› 9...) from fallback fonts; 196 viewBox sites (158 on 960-grid, 32 on 24-grid); vertical-align -0.15em/-0.2em/-1px/middle; 22 glyph-centering exemptions; a registry that silently truncates (podcast) or falls back (tv -> info).

rootCauses.title: Rows do not reserve columns
rootCauses.detail: About 25 flex row families render optional children conditionally (only .stable-row is a grid), with 7 padding pairs and 4 gaps; absent actions collapse their column and confirmations change width in flow.

rootCauses.title: Desktop state model on a touch device
rootCauses.detail: 112 :hover lines against 1 @media (hover:hover) block (census: 92 of 94 hover rules ungated); only 9 :active rules; a global a:hover underline outranks component resets; disabled is not excluded from hover/active.

rootCauses.title: No native-interaction policy
rootCauses.detail: -webkit-touch-callout:none on 3 sites, -webkit-user-select on 4 lines, 5 unprefixed-only user-select rules inert on iOS, tap-highlight only in skins, contextmenu handled only for reorder. Locked policy: only editable fields selectable, copy via explicit actions, desktop right-click opens FileTube's menu.

rootCauses.title: Colour roles missing: red and phantom tokens do every job
rootCauses.detail: 16 place-named colour tokens per era/mode with no --selected, --danger, --focus-ring, --hover or status roles; --yt-red never re-tuned for dark (~3:1 text); phantom --hover-bg (7 uses), --input-bg (5), --btn-primary-text (4) with 0 definitions; hover backgrounds use 10 different values; global link colour leaks into card titles.

rootCauses.title: Overlays and feedback are hand-built per feature
rootCauses.detail: 22 sheet/menu/modal families with 6 backgrounds, 3 radii, 3 shadows, 8 backdrop classes, local z 30/50 for menus; half animate, half pop in; 30 distinct transition shapes with no enter/exit easing pair; native alert/confirm in admin; toasts unmanaged; 15 bespoke empty states.

rootCauses.title: Viewport breakpoints used as modes, with layout-property motion
rootCauses.detail: Pocket's takeover is gated by max-width:768 in both CSS and JS (two writers), rebuilt by innerHTML on every crossing; margin-left transition on .main-content; display owned in three places (48 JS .style.display writes, 72 inline display:none, 39 display !important); one-shot measurements with no ResizeObserver.
